observations: Two solar panels leaning against a wall.
Monocrystalline cell pattern (octagonal cells with white diamonds).
Watermark 'EMMYBESTSOLAR' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.
No brand, model, or technical specifications are visible on the front.

risks.proof: Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in sunlight.
Close-up photos of cells or an electroluminescence (EL) test (unlikely for remote sale).

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel showing wattage, voltage, and brand.
Photo of the back of the panels to see the junction box and cables.
Dimensions (length and width) of the panels.
response.reason: The capacity (wattage) of the solar panels is not visible. Since solar panels are priced based on their power output, a valuation is impossible without seeing the manufacturer's label on the back.
